name: Digital Ange ~Dennou Tenshi SS~
original_name: デジタルアンジュ ～電脳天使SS～
source:
Is it difficult to be kind to people? Do you believe that love is stronger than weapons? 

The end of the world grows near. Whether it can be saved or not depends on the answers to these questions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
善待他人，是一件困难的事吗？你相信爱比武器更强大吗？

世界末日正逐渐逼近。这个世界能否得救，取决于这些问题的答案。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
